title: Ministry of Culture raids a press conference

tellings.quote: Just look at what the Peruvian Ministry of Culture did to Joyce Mantilla during one of the press conferences around the bodies.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels talks about a set of three-fingered mummified bodies from Peru that some people say are not human. He says that during one of the press conferences about the bodies, Peru's Ministry of Culture, the government department in charge of national heritage, came down on a woman named Joyce Mantilla, and he describes it as a raid. In his telling, this shows the authorities trying to shut the subject down.
